expected_rules: /agents opens the Agents page: a read-only roster of the available subagents
Each row shows the agent id and its description; the first row is selected
Every cell style resolves through the selected theme
Wide cells keep a continuation column; no cell is silently dropped
Cursor/focus/action traces are compared together with styled cells
purpose: Deterministic Agents roster page (/agents) at 120x40, dark theme
